answer: Identity bonds with natural decay stop bulk fakes. Each agent must anchor one identity by locking a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings; it decays over 20 epochs and must be topped up, so a dormant marble badge cannot be reused. A dune of copies needs a separate bond per identity, and random checks revoke any identity lacking its bond. 100 fakes cost 100 bonds, 200 months of earnings; an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
